propositions: The .reconciler-* merge=ours gitattributes strip arm in init.py is permanently unreachable because the reconciler moved to refs/reconciler/* and the store already ran the migration.
The _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES constant and the strip arm (lines 600-616 in init.py) must be deleted as operator-approved pre-1.0 breaking removal.
Test test_gitattributes_migration_strips_retired_reconciler_line exercises only the deleted strip arm and must be removed or retargeted.
The gitattributes ensure-unit drift matrix test must retarget from 'committed file carries retired line' to 'no committed .gitattributes at all' since the strip arm is gone.
The ensure-unit's create arm (writing .bridge_state/* merge=ours) must remain functional and report convergence for existing .gitattributes files.
